headline: Diwali Sweet Retailers Face Higher Costs as Sugar Prices Jump 30%
summary: Rising domestic prices for sugar, edible oils, and nuts are driving up input costs for Indian confectioners, forcing sweet shops to increase consumer prices during the festive season.
why: Diwali confectionery sales represent a major seasonal revenue surge for India's food service and agricultural supply chains.

impacts.name: Indian Food Processing Sector
impacts.why: A 30% spike in raw sugar costs squeezes profit margins during peak festive sales.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
